scope: One independent science/source-topic review of all n15/n16 modern prose blocks and task-fidelity review of the five n16 written questions, reusing the prior blind solutions.
source_binding: Actual bytes match all three supplied freezes. Each embedded source.data equals its faithful source object. Lesson identities, titles, numbering, page origins, figure inventories and exercise counts match. All 20 prose source_text values and block/source mappings, all five written source_text values and exercise mappings, and every original dollar-delimited formula/data/label span are retained. All numeric_changes lists are empty; written lines reconstruct text exactly. No new dynamical equation or changed equation label was introduced.

phy10-c1-s2-n15.evidence: Retains periodic forcing and enhanced resonant response, with effective modal coupling and near-natural-frequency conditions. Force amplitude, damping, duration and system limits qualify growth; neither every periodic force nor every resonance implies unlimited amplitude or destruction.

Preserves bridges, machine bases/shafts, hulls, reciprocating parts and misalignment, while allowing multiple natural modes. Cyclic loading can cause fatigue/crack development despite static stress below ultimate strength; conditional wording avoids inevitable immediate failure or a universal fatigue threshold.

Retains dissipation and changing system/driving conditions as mitigation, acknowledging a finite resonance band rather than relying on exact frequency inequality. Ship-heading and non-lockstep bridge examples remain source-attributed; altered excitation/coupling and possible risk are explained without guaranteed mitigation or guaranteed collapse.

Preserves useful cradle resonance. Appropriately timed pushes along motion transfer positive work, with small damping and a compatible driving cadence. Useful operation is not equated with unlimited or always desirable amplitude.

Preserves the reed frequency meter, end masses, common support strip and dependence of natural frequency on elasticity, length and mass. Calibration under specified conditions is required; schematic proportions introduce no physical dimensions or precision.
The fig-20 text marker, identity and source location are retained. This is a marker check only, not a pixel or apparatus approval.
The source fig-20 caption is unchanged; no numeric reading or additional physical claim is added.

Retains electromagnetic support driving, forced reed response and inferring AC frequency from calibration. Multiple reeds may respond; a large response is conditional on drive/damping. Mechanical forcing frequency is not assumed identical to electrical frequency without an instrument-specific mapping, and no unprovided accuracy or scale value is asserted.
The source's later-application transition remains; the added requirement to consider drive, intrinsic properties and damping does not invent an application or omit a taught topic.
The fig-21 text marker and source location are retained. No rendered geometry, labels or readings are approved here.

phy10-c1-s2-n16.evidence: The initial loss/replenishment statements are scoped to a resistive system. Damped forced motion can be sustained by periodic driving, while self-motion uses a reservoir or continuing supply and state-dependent feedback. No independent external timing signal does not mean no force, no energy consumption or lossless motion.
The source's cross-page fig-21 caption is retained. Its presence does not introduce a new self-oscillator or constitute approval of a figure/layout.

Preserves weight/spring energy storage, wheel-pointer coupling, ab and alternating a/b pallets, source-described left/right pushes and two energy transfers per cycle. Feedback gates the supply to compensate loss; directions and pulse count are explicitly schematic/source-specific, not exact timing or geometry measurements or a universal escapement law.
The fig-22 marker and source identity are unchanged; this does not verify the drawn escapement.
The source fig-22 caption remains unchanged without an added physical value.

Near-natural clock frequency is conditioned on small amplitude, damping and impulse effects; rate is not invariant to length/environment/escapement. The 1657 date, Dutch identity and Huygens statement are preserved as an explicit source quotation, not independently verified priority or complete clock history. Spring balance wheels, interrupter bells, organ pipes, whistles and heart/lung analogies remain, with energy/regulation requirements and no isolated-lung perpetual-oscillator or clinical claim.

Self-oscillation retains energy supply and feedback without independently prescribed external periodic timing. The source's non-damping terminology is explained as sustained operation rather than zero dissipation; exhaustion or failed operating conditions can stop motion.

For the stable driven response discussed here, the driving frequency sets the response cadence; amplitude also depends on system properties, forcing and damping, with initial transients separated. Self amplitude/frequency include supply, feedback and loss. Convergence of different starts is conditional on entering the same stable state, allowing start-up thresholds/multiple states. Damped free motion decays while ideal lossless free motion need not, so persistence alone is not a classification.
Only the ornamental source separator is removed as a declared layout change; no scientific prose, identity, datum or relation is removed.

Preserves the chapter synthesis, spacecraft/planet comparison, instantaneous position/velocity, amplitude/period and the driving-versus-natural-frequency comparison. It does not discard kinematics or let frequency ratio alone determine response strength; energy, loss and transient versus operating-state distinctions remain explicit.

written_reviews.evidence: Retains actual indoor/street observation and learner-selected examples. Asking about the system, periodic driver and frequency-selective evidence preserves physical reasoning without asserting that visible vibration proves resonance. Honest non-observation/uncertainty is allowed; no fabricated personal experience or dangerous experiment is required.

Both 50 N and 0.005 N, the two-way spring-return door and same handle are retained. An explicit linear lossless model resolves the source's forcing ambiguity. A constant small force cannot maintain the reference opening, whereas properly timed repeated work can accumulate energy over time; the prompt requires explanation and prohibits inferring unprovided opening time/amplitude or universal real-door success.
written_reviews.capacity_change: The static-versus-resonantly-timed strategy is now given as a comparison prompt rather than left for independent discovery. Qualitative timing/work, continuing input and model-limit reasoning remain required; this is nonblocking scaffolding, not unchanged strategy-generation capacity.

written_reviews.evidence: Retains explanation of pronounced resonance, with comparable drive/coupling, near-linearity, small damping and frequency tuning. Steady versus short-duration forcing is distinguished; ideal undamped sustained resonance is not generalized to real finite responses or inevitable damage. The listed factors scaffold explanation without giving their required causal relationships.

Still requires generating examples outside the lesson's full retained list. Energy source, state-dependent feedback, loss compensation and absence of an independently timed periodic drive must be explained. No new example is supplied, and merely having energy or repeated movement is correctly insufficient.

Retains the open three-way comparison of energy supply, timing, frequency/amplitude and transient versus steady behavior. Feedback versus imposed forcing and conditional initial-impulse independence remain tasks to explain. Including ideal lossless free motion prevents the false decay-only distinction and matches the prior independent solution.

limits: All 20 prose entries were checked, including caption/figure identities and the nonsemantic separator. Figure checks are text-marker checks only: no original/modern pixels, apparatus geometry or render was inspected or approved.

The five written judgments reuse the bound source-only blind solutions; no choice text, author answer/key, t17 re-review, external historical/clinical verification, finalization or publication approval is included.
